name: Accidental data disclosure
description: An authorised user inadvertently exposes information — misdirected email, wrong recipient, public share, or misdelivery.

name: Hardware or software failure
description: An unplanned outage or malfunction of equipment or software degrades or interrupts service, or corrupts data.

name: Lost or stolen device or media
description: A laptop, phone, or removable medium containing information is lost or stolen.

name: Security misconfiguration
description: A system, service or cloud resource is deployed with insecure settings (open storage, default credentials, excess permissions).

name: Data exfiltration
description: Unauthorised transfer of information out of the organisation's control.

name: Denial of service (DoS/DDoS)
description: Flooding or resource-exhaustion attack that degrades or removes the availability of a system or service.

name: Exploitation of an unpatched vulnerability
description: Compromise via a known, unremediated vulnerability for which a patch or mitigation exists but has not been applied.

name: Exploitation of a public-facing application
description: An attacker abuses a vulnerability or weakness in an internet-facing web application or service (e.g. injection, insecure logic).

name: Interception of internal network traffic
description: Interception of traffic travelling across the organisation's internal networks.

name: Malicious insider misuse
description: An authorised person deliberately abuses their access to steal, alter, or sabotage information or systems.

name: Malware infection
description: Non-ransomware malicious code (trojans, spyware, loaders) that establishes a foothold, steals data, or disrupts operations.

name: Phishing targeting user credentials
description: Deceptive messages that trick users into revealing their sign-in credentials, typically by email or a lookalike sign-in page.

name: Physical intrusion or theft
description: Unauthorised physical access to premises, equipment, or storage to obtain or damage information assets.

name: Privilege escalation
description: An attacker or user gains rights beyond those authorised, moving from limited to elevated or administrative access.

name: Ransomware
description: Malicious software encrypts systems and data for extortion, increasingly combined with data theft (double extortion).

name: Stolen or compromised credentials
description: Use of valid but illegitimately obtained credentials (theft, reuse, brute force, or purchase) to access systems.

name: Supply chain or third-party compromise
description: Attack delivered through a trusted supplier, service provider, or software component (e.g. compromised update or vendor access).

name: Unauthorised data modification
description: Deliberate tampering with data or configuration to corrupt records, falsify information, or undermine trust.

name: Zero-day exploitation
description: Compromise using a previously unknown vulnerability for which no patch yet exists.

name: Natural disaster or environmental event
description: Fire, flood, storm, extended power loss, or similar event that damages facilities or interrupts operations.
